top_ai_signals.name: Metadata & Provenance
top_ai_signals.summary: The file's embedded provenance marks it as AI-generated.
top_ai_signals.what_found: The provenance metadata flags this as trained-algorithmic (AI-generated) media.
top_ai_signals.why_it_matters: Provenance markers like C2PA are an industry-standard, hard-to-fake trace written by the generator itself. Finding one is among the strongest provenance signals available.
top_ai_signals.caveat: Provenance can be stripped or, rarely, forged. Absence of a marker is not proof of authenticity.

top_ai_signals.name: Spectral Artifacts
top_ai_signals.summary: The Six-Lens model scored this image 90.8% AI and 9.2% authentic, a extremely high-confidence finding toward synthetic generation.
top_ai_signals.what_found: All six spectral lenses, covering visual texture (ConvNeXt), frequency grids (FFT), sensor noise simulation (SRM), color-space fingerprints (YCbCr), spatial reconstruction (SPAI), and robustness testing, collectively scored this image 90.8% AI. A score this strong, the majority of lenses independently flagged patterns like periodic frequency grids and noise distributions inconsistent with any known camera sensor profile.
top_ai_signals.why_it_matters: This model looks for patterns invisible to the human eye, buried in the pixel-level math of the image. A 90.8% score means the statistical fingerprint aligns significantly more with AI generation than camera physics, and these frequency-domain traces are very hard to remove without visibly degrading the image.
top_ai_signals.caveat: Heavy JPEG compression, aggressive resizing, or strong image filters can partially destroy the frequency-domain signals this model depends on, potentially softening a confident AI detection into an inconclusive result. Conversely, very new or unusual AI generators not present in training data may produce lower-than-expected scores.

top_inconclusive_signals.name: Lighting Physics & Contrast Geometry
top_inconclusive_signals.summary: The lighting is balanced and well-behaved (255/255 range, 102.8/255 mean, 0.023% clipping) - matching both a well-exposed real photo and a capable AI generator.
top_inconclusive_signals.what_found: The image has a 255/255 dynamic range, 102.8/255 mean brightness, and only 0.023% clipped highlights with 0.004% crushed shadows. This balanced exposure is realistic-looking but not diagnostic - it fits equally well for a careful real photograph and a modern AI generator.
top_inconclusive_signals.why_it_matters: Lighting is most useful when it's either suspiciously perfect (AI) or clearly clipping (real). A balanced middle-ground doesn't give us enough to work with, so this signal defers to others.
top_inconclusive_signals.caveat: HDR post-processing, tone mapping, strong flash, and professional retouching can all alter exposure profiles - introducing 'AI-like' qualities into real photos or vice versa.
